# Dev Jani Portfolio

> The official portfolio of Dev Jani, an AI researcher, cybersecurity practitioner, and software engineer in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/): profile, selected outcomes, and current focus.
- [Research](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/research): edge LLM alignment, federated learning, smart grids, and sustainable AI.
- [Projects](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/projects): selected AI, security, IoT, and software systems.
- [Experience](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/experience): research, cybersecurity, software engineering, and leadership experience.
- [About](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/about): background, technical skills, and operating principles.
- [Contact](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/contact): professional contact details and collaboration information.
- [Privacy](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/privacy): privacy practices for this portfolio.

## Agent and developer resources

- [Sitemap](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): indexable public URLs.
- [Agent endpoint](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp): MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint exposing portfolio lookup tools.
- [MCP manifest](https://d-ev-portfolio.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json): endpoint metadata and available tools.

This is a personal portfolio, not a public product API. For research or engineering collaboration, use the contact page or email dev.j.jani2004@gmail.com.
